examples.english: “Hearken, therefore, my Lord, that I may set forth the word in openness. As thy | power hath prophesied through Solomon: 'A stream came forth and became a great wide flood,'--this is: The light-stream hath spread itself out in the chaos over all the regions of the emanations of Self-willed. And again the word which thy power hath spoken through Solomon: 'It tore away all to itself”

examples.english: And thy seed shall be as the sand of the earth; and it shall spread abroad to the sea, and the south, and the north, and to the east; and in thee and in thy seed shall all the tribes of the earth be blessed.
